digest.component_or_area: test suite timing and window optimization
propositions: Multi-second test-only wall-clock windows in review-bot bootstrap (~10.15s), lock-retry (~15.56s), shutdown (~9s), and autodeploy (~11.25s) add cumulative test execution overhead without testing production timeout or retry logic
Production timeout, retry, drain, health, and backoff defaults must remain unchanged and byte-for-byte identical across all modifications
Real subprocess, lock, process-group, and health boundary execution must be preserved in all shortened test cases while only test-owned clocks and passive wait windows are injected or scaled

Focused test suite was shortened from median 56.22s to 29.31s (47.9% reduction), exceeding the 50% target for individual families and the 20s aggregate wall reduction bar, while all acceptance criteria remain validated
